name: Agensi Skills MCP
description: Agensi (skill marketplace) as native mcp__agensi__* tools in DeepSeek Harness: a direct Streamable HTTP MCP connection with a sign-in card in the plugin page — OAuth 2.1, live status and expiry, no pasted tokens.
longDescription:
Connects DeepSeek Harness to the Agensi MCP endpoint (`https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp/auth`, Streamable HTTP) and registers its toolkit as `mcp__agensi__*`: `search_skills`, `get_skill`, `my_library`, `my_credits`, `quote_tool` / `run_tool` / `check_job` for Agensi's own image, video, voice, music and data tools, `find_tools`, `skill_tools`, and the creator tools.

The endpoint is protected by OAuth 2.1, and the harness MCP client speaks a URL plus static headers only — no interactive authorization, no token store. This bundle supplies both halves the harness lacks. The Host half registers a public OAuth client through dynamic client registration, runs authorization-code + PKCE (S256) with the RFC 8707 `resource` indicator, listens on `127.0.0.1:8791` (8792/8793 when taken) for the browser callback, exchanges the code inside the harness process, and stores the token in `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/agensi-mcp/config.json` (mode 0600 on POSIX; the user profile ACL on Windows). The MCP row reads that file through a Loader `!!js` expression, so nothing secret is committed and no token is typed anywhere. There is deliberately no anonymous mode and no API-key field.

The plugin page carries the sign-in card: status dot and label, expiry as local time plus a countdown, granted scopes, the last error verbatim, and Sign in / Sign in again / Sign out / Cancel. It follows the harness UI language (English and Chinese built in) rather than the OS language, and repaints on a language switch. Tokens live one hour; the Host half renews five minutes before expiry and re-composes the MCP row, so a long session keeps working unattended. Sign-in, renewal, sign-out and failures all land in `status.json` / `plugin.log`.

Paid skills and paid tool calls are never bought automatically: `get_skill` and `run_tool` are only used after the user says yes.
